resourceProfile.assessment: The complete English and German source scope, review metadata, glossary, and project concept references were available locally.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation review metadata, queue validation, typecheck, 79 test files with 462 tests, complete build, 39 IIS rules with 61 route cases, and 724 generated-link checks passed.

linguisticCritique.summary: An independent whole-locale pass identified 25 actionable German translation defects in battery evidence, safety, and profile text; all 25 were corrected in this bounded iteration.

competentHumanReview.summary: No competent German human review was performed in this cycle; changed IDs remain machine-drafted.

publicationAuthorization.summary: No merge, publication, deployment, or residual-risk authorization was requested or granted.

findings.summary: The removable-cell summary was grammatically serviceable but unnecessarily relative and less concise.
evidence: Before: Eine herausnehmbare wiederaufladbare Zelle, die in kompatiblen Geräten verwendet wird.

findings.summary: The integrated-battery summary needed a more direct German user-replacement phrase.
evidence: Before: Ein interner Akku im Gerät statt einer vom Benutzer austauschbaren Zelle.
findings.resolution: Normalized the summary while preserving the integrated-versus-removable distinction.
